title: America & Britain Nearly Went To War Over A Pig 🐖
caption:
True story. In 1859 a shot pig nearly started a war between the US and Britain. The only casualty was the pig. 🐖
Would you have shot the pig? 👇
first_comment: 12 years of two armies sharing one island over a potato-eating pig. Who was the REAL villain here? 🐖👇
